decisions.reason: The modular plant concept is central to the firm's announced direction of modular, cleaner solutions, and it is publicly backed by a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so the firm is committed to it and has nothing to write off.
The slow-speed shredder is a core product with its own web page, which signals visible commitment and substantial investment, and it sits close to the established offer where demand is growing.

This second modular concept is only mentioned and shows no reported results, so it is less entrenched, but it fits the announced modular strategy and is too new for its results to be judged a failure rather than a temporary shortfall.
The trommel screen is close to the firm's established line, so continuing it costs little, and the firm has an interest in protecting what it has already invested in its development.
